query: I have an idea for a content campaign around facility rental revenue for districts, but I haven't pinned down the angle yet. Help me think through it.
expected_behavior: Asks one question at a time and waits for the answer before the next, never dumping all the questions in a single message

Walks the ideation stages in order (frame the problem not the solution, identify a specific audience, pressure-test real vs imagined demand, imagine the outcomes, risk and constraint check, inputs and adjacency)
Does NOT produce the content itself (no outline or draft) - it produces the thinking and grounds any angle in the specific audience

Before drafting, requires an explicit Drive or Confluence destination plus owner and approver, then publishes one structured Ideation Note without clobbering and returns its durable URL, review state, owner, approver, target surface, Jira key, assets, and named website handoff
Uses one unique scratch workspace and removes it on publishing success or failure; never treats a temporary path as the completed note
Produces copy with no em dashes (Facilitron voice)
